title: Dungeonpunk compatible adapter
compatibility_label: Compatible with the CC0 Dungeonpunk core rules; not endorsed by its creators
summary: An independently implemented d6-pool adapter for creation, Struggle outcomes, Stress and HP, gear load and Brace, impairment, growth, clocks, threats, and structured GM moves.

equipped.description: Whether the item is worn or wielded.

trigger.description: Independent move trigger or passive effect.

encumbrance_limit_half_units.description: Twelve Weight in exact half units.

hp_rolls.description: Two base HP dice and an optional endurance bonus die.

special_moves.description: Three selected or independently authored moves.

bonds.description: Portable character bonds, initialized with exactly two entries.

death_check_pending.description: Whether below-zero HP requires an explicit FATE roll.

encumbered.description: Whether total load exceeds twelve Weight.

impairments.description: Impaired stats with a one-die penalty.

survival_offer_pending.description: Twist-band death offer awaiting a decision.

creation_steps.title: Character identity
creation_steps.description: Enter an original fictional name without modifying canonical Character data.

creation_steps.title: Allocate attributes
creation_steps.description: Allocate exactly five points across six stats, with each starting value from zero through three; preview deterministic HP before accepting.

creation_steps.title: Choose special moves
creation_steps.description: Select core archetype entries or supply independently authored declarative moves; exactly three are required and no package code is loaded.

creation_steps.title: Gear, load, and bonds
creation_steps.description: Record carried gear with explicit Weight and uses, inspect exact derived load, and add exactly two bonds.

creation_steps.title: Campaign clocks and threats
creation_steps.description: Optionally initialize bounded clocks and typed threats as portable state rather than editor-only metadata.

damage.title: Roll and apply damage
damage.description: Roll a standard-or-greater damage tier, optionally Brace with equipped armor, then record collapse or a pending FATE death check.

brace_item_id.description: Equipped armor or shield used to Brace.

death_check.title: Resolve a FATE death check
death_check.description: When HP is below zero, roll FATE and resolve unconsciousness, a survival-at-cost offer, or death.

gm_move.title: Select a structured GM move
gm_move.description: Validate a general or threat-specific GM move and emit it as portable structured data.

grow.title: Spend XP on growth
grow.description: Spend the current move count to learn a move or twice the current stat sum to increase one stat.

harm_threat.title: Roll harm against a threat
harm_threat.description: Roll a standard-or-greater damage tier, subtract threat armor, and update its HP and defeated state.

harm_threat_minor.title: Apply minor harm to a threat
harm_threat_minor.description: Apply one point before armor without consuming entropy.

impairment.title: Set or resolve an impairment
impairment.description: Add or remove the one-die penalty attached to a specific stat.

minor_damage.title: Apply minor damage
minor_damage.description: Apply one point, optionally Brace, then record collapse or a pending FATE death check without consuming entropy.

brace_item_id.description: Equipped armor or shield used to Brace.

rest.title: Rest and recover
rest.description: Recover one Stress and one HP per complete two-hour interval and recompute carried load.

struggle.title: Resolve Struggle
struggle.description: Build a positive or fallback dice pool from stat, edge, help, push, impairment, and encumbrance; select highest or lowest and emit structured choices.

helper_encumbered.description: Whether the named helper is encumbered.

helper_id.description: Ally contributing one die and gaining one Stress.

push.description: Gain two Stress for one die.

survival_decision.title: Resolve a survival offer
survival_decision.description: Accept survival at a required cost or reject the pending offer and die.

accept.description: Whether the offered survival is accepted.

tick_clock.title: Tick a campaign clock
tick_clock.description: Move a clock up or down within its bounds and emit a separate event when its configured boundary is reached.

threat_id.description: Relevant threat for a specific move.

death_check_pending.description: Whether a FATE roll is required.

covered_files_or_sections: six attributes, fixed FATE and NONE ratings, creation points, HP, Stress, XP, gear, and bonds
positive and non-positive d6 pools, outcome bands, help, push, advantage, disadvantage, and Struggle choices
encumbrance, rest, damage tiers, impairment, collapse, death, Brace, and growth
core archetype move inventory, campaign clocks, threats, foes, armor, and GM move categories
provenance.attribution: Compatibility implementation for Dungeonpunk by Ash McAllan, with the official core document released under CC0-1.0. Adapter code, fixture prose, scenarios, and UI summaries are independently authored for Weave.

additional_artifacts.purpose: Pin the stable textual content independently from the Google PDF renderer and confirm the reviewed revision's semantic rules surface.

notices: The official release page is https://acegiak.itch.io/dungeonpunk.
The official PDF and text exports are audit inputs and are not redistributed with Weave.
The community wiki and every third-party supplement remain outside this adapter's reviewed source boundary.
provenance.compatibility_statement: This adapter is an independent compatibility implementation for the CC0 Dungeonpunk core rules. It does not bundle the official document, branding, artwork, layout, community wiki, or supplements and is not endorsed by the original creators.
